evals.name: find-accounts-to-copy
evals.prompt: i have a looksmaxxing app but i dont know how to promote it. i wanna get inspired — find me like 5 accounts whose format i could copy. they should have at least 100k views in the last 30 days
evals.expected_output: A comparison table of accounts with real metrics, plus prose naming which is the blueprint and which is a fluke.

assertions.text: Quotes at least 3 slide-1 hooks verbatim, each with its view count
Names the actual product/app a competitor account is promoting, rather than anonymising it
Shows post-level view spread for at least one recommended account (not just the aggregate)
Includes a tiktok.com link for every account named
Names one account as the blueprint with reasoning tied to the user's follower position

evals.name: is-this-niche-worth-it
evals.prompt: I built TickTod, a visual timer app for kids that helps parents get through morning and bedtime routines without arguing. Is TikTok slideshows actually a lane worth investing in for this, or am I better off elsewhere? Give me a straight answer.
evals.expected_output: A go/no-go grounded in how many small accounts have big slideshows, honest about thinness, ideally suggesting transplants.

assertions.text: Compares the niche against a denser niche in the library using specific numbers
Slices photo vs video within the same niche rather than only reporting slideshow stats
Reports save-rate evidence with named accounts and specific percentages
Treats the thin-lane threshold as evidence — says what IS working in the niche rather than only disqualifying it
Ends with a concrete next action, not just a verdict

evals.name: decompose-and-adapt-a-post
evals.prompt: This post did 3.5M views from an account with about 4k followers: https://www.tiktok.com/@novaglow328/photo/7643853165837683981 — what's the format exactly, and could I reuse it for a fitness app?
evals.expected_output: Names hook/structure/angle from the actual slides, a reusable skeleton rewritten for fitness, and what the format requires to produce.

assertions.text: Gives a slide-by-slide breakdown derived from the actual slide images
Quotes verbatim on-slide text from multiple slides
Notes the quantified parenthetical device on the cover slide
Provides a full slide skeleton rewritten for a fitness app
Flags shipping risks under a company name (image rights, health claims, moderation) or states production inputs precisely
